explanation: Compared against Bellaïche–Nicolas, 'Parité des coefficients de formes modulaires' (Ramanujan J. 40 (2016); author's version paritecoefV5.pdf on J.-L. Nicolas's homepage). The abstract states 'A_1(x) ⩾ 0.037 √x/(log x)^{7/8} holds for x ⩾ 2', where A_1(x) is the number of n ⩽ x with p(n) odd, and Théorème 6 proves A_1(x) > 0.037 (√x/log x)(log x)^{1/8} for x ⩾ 2 (the same bound). The Lean statement: ∀ x ≥ 2, 0.037·√x/(log x)^{7/8} ≤ #{n ∈ ℕ : n ≤ x ∧ p(n) odd}. This matches; if the paper counts only n ≥ 1, the Lean count additionally includes n = 0 (p(0) = 1 is odd), which only makes the Lean statement weaker, so it is still implied. (The paper's introduction quotes 0.048 in (1.17), but the abstract and the theorem give 0.037, the constant used here.) Faithful.
